title: History-Conditioned Inference of Memory and Stochastic Forcing in Generalized Langevin Equations under Lévy Noise
summary: We consider the identification of memory and stochastic forcing in a one-dimensional generalized Langevin equation with state-dependent Brownian noise and optional additive symmetric $α$-stable jumps. A finite-dimensional Markov embedding provides Kramers--Moyal conditional moment relations that separate memory drift, Brownian diffusion, and jump contributions.
